verdict.rationale: Notte has a pricing page mentioning credits and free trial without a card, but there's no documented per-task/per-browser-hour rate or concurrency limits in the evidence, and community feedback explicitly states the pricing page fails to explain what a credit actually buys, calling the credit-based scheme confusing and 'broken.' missing for 10: concrete per-task/per-hour rate cards, documented concurrency/rate limits, resolution of the credit-transparency complaints.
